proposals.mechanism: A strong RTH opening drive followed by a shallow pullback to VWAP traps early countertrend traders while late continuation participants defend the developing volume-weighted reference. Continuation after the pullback should outperform unconditional VWAP pullbacks only when the first impulse and session participation are strong.

A narrow morning balance inside a VWAP-centered auction can represent compressed participation. A buffered breakout from a short compression window attempts to capture the transition from balance to initiative trade before the move becomes crowded.

A probe far from VWAP that fails to hold extension can trap late momentum participants. A bounded VWAP rejection fade should work only when the distance is large enough to pay for friction but not so large that the session has become a clean trend day.
